name: offers
title: Offers
summary: How one seller (or the Official Store) sells one variant in one condition: price and authentic was-price, purchase limit, seller SKU, dispatch, shipping profile, return and warranty terms, offer status, and the published featured-offer rule that picks the main offer for a delivery location.
owns: Offers: seller (or Official Store) × variant × condition, with condition notes and stated missing accessories
Price, compare-at (was) price with a verified basis, sale end time, purchase limit, seller SKU
Offer terms: dispatch time, shipping profile reference, return terms (platform baseline or more generous), warranty
Offer status: Draft, Active, Paused, Out of stock, Ineligible, Removed (with reason)
Price history and price changes (scheduled, approval-gated for the Official Store)
Featured-offer rule (versioned, published), eligibility and ineligibility reasons, featured-offer selection per variant and delivery zone
Comparable totals per delivery location for the purchase box and the all-offers page
Seller and Official Store bulk price and quantity file updates with preview and correction report
Frozen offer snapshots for order items (seller, condition, price, terms accepted at purchase)
notOwns: Shared product content (title, specs, included items, variants): catalog
Stock quantities, reservations and adjustments: inventory (offers reads availability and passes bulk quantity rows to inventory)
Shipping rates, delivery estimates and seller shipping profiles: shipping (offers stores the profile id and asks shipping for quotes)
Return policy baseline and category exceptions: returns (offers validates against it)
Seller status, restrictions and performance figures: sellers
Discounts, coupons and campaign prices: promotions (offers only shows the automatic discount promotions reports for an offer)
Company trading summary (sales, margin, discounts, returns): finance and reports
Fee previews on the offer form: finance fee rules

title.desc: Product title with the variant label (e.g. 'Aurora Headphones – Black'), copied from catalog when the offer is created and kept current from catalog.product.updated / catalog.product.merged. Used for admin and seller title search and by modules that list offers without catalog (shipping profile usage).

conditionNotes.desc: Required for used and refurbished; shown beside the price

includedItems.desc: What is in this seller's box (defaults to the product's included items)

missingItems.desc: Product's standard included items that this offer does not include. Must be stated; shown as 'Missing: …'

missingItemsStale.desc: True when the product's box changed (catalog.product.updated) and missingItems names items no longer in it, or no longer lists everything absent. The seller is asked to review (offers.offer.missing_items_stale); cleared when the seller saves missingItems again, changed or confirmed as is (offers.offer.missing_items_reviewed). The offer stays on sale meanwhile.

sellerSku.desc: Seller's own code; customers do not see it

stockItemId.desc: inventory stock item that holds this offer's quantities

dispatch.desc: The seller's own dispatch terms as saved. For a Marketly-fulfilled offer they are kept but have no customer effect; read shipping for what customers get

shippingProfileId.desc: shipping module profile (rates, services, coverage) as saved by the seller; see shipping for the effective one

fulfilledBy.desc: Who ships it: official_warehouse for Official Store offers, marketly_service while fulfillment-service fulfils the offer (fulfillment-service.offer.service_changed), else seller

shipping.desc: Effective customer-facing fulfilment: seller offers = their own shippingProfileId and dispatch; Official Store as today; marketly_service = fulfillment-service.getServiceTerms (Marketly's profile, dispatch and ships-from). Cart, checkout, delivery estimates and the featured rule read this, never shippingProfileId and dispatch directly

publishOnApproval.desc: Draft on a product still in catalog review goes live when the product is approved

termsVersion.desc: Increments on any customer-visible change; carts compare it to detect changes

basis.desc: lowest_30_days: this offer's lowest price in the 30 days before the sale; list_price: the manufacturer list price catalog staff set on the variant (a list price in seller-entered specs, e.g. MSRP, is not evidence)

verified.desc: Checked against price history or the list price on file. Unverified was-prices are never shown.

explanation.desc: e.g. 'Was price is the Official Store's lowest price in the 30 days before the sale.'

sameDayCutoff.desc: Local cutoff HH:mm for same-day dispatch, market time zone

shipsFrom.desc: City and region, e.g. 'Reno, NV'. Official Store offers: the inventory default location (inventory.getDefaultLocation), set at save and refreshed by the hourly offers.reevaluate-eligibility job when that location changes (inventory publishes no location event; the refresh does not bump termsVersion); seller offers: the seller's ships-from address from shipping seller settings. Never empty: falls back to the market default location label (kernel config).

profileId.desc: Shipping profile customers are quoted with: the offer's own, or the service profile (fulfillment-service ServiceTerms.shippingProfileId) for marketly_service

dispatch.desc: Dispatch promise and ships-from customers see; for marketly_service the service dispatch and shipsFrom from fulfillment-service ServiceTerms

kind.desc: extended = more generous than the platform baseline for the category

categoryException.desc: Category exception text shown before purchase: returns' summary when resolveTerms answered source category_exception at save (column return_category_exception); null otherwise

summary.desc: e.g. '30-day returns. You pay return shipping unless the item is faulty.'

policyVersion.desc: returns policy version (EffectiveTerms.policyVersion, e.g. '1.0') the terms were validated against at save; null when returns was off

message.desc: Customer-safe text, e.g. 'Not eligible for featured offer: delivery performance under review'

code.desc: fulfillment_service_suspended: the seller's Fulfilled by Marketly enrollment is suspended or offboarding, so the offer stops selling (it never switches to seller shipping); restored when the enrollment is reinstated or the SKU leaves the service

affectedActivity.desc: For restrictions: what is stopped, e.g. 'Refurbished offers and new listings'

appealRoute.desc: For restrictions and removals: how to appeal

quantity.desc: Initial available quantity; recorded in inventory as 'Initial stock'

publish.desc: Publish immediately when the product is purchasable; otherwise saved as draft

stockItemId.desc: Existing company stock item; omitted = create one at the default warehouse

condition.desc: Draft only; afterwards end the offer and create a new one

price.desc: Sellers only; Official Store prices change through price-changes

confirmLargeChange.desc: The seller confirms a price change above largeSellerPriceChangePct. Without it such a PATCH returns LARGE_PRICE_CHANGE_UNCONFIRMED (details.offers) and nothing is saved; with it the change applies like any other edit.

windowDays.desc: Required for extended; at least the category baseline

label.desc: e.g. 'Free delivery Thu, Oct 15' or 'Arrives Fri, Oct 16 – Mon, Oct 19'

freeOver.desc: Free-shipping threshold for this seller, if any

shipsFrom.desc: Effective ships-from (Offer.shipping.dispatch.shipsFrom): for marketly_service the Marketly warehouse, e.g. 'Reno, NV (Marketly warehouse)'

fulfilledByLabel.desc: 'Ships from Marketly' for marketly_service offers (the seller stays named in seller); null otherwise

orderWithinMinutes.desc: Countdown to the cutoff that keeps this date

locationLabel.desc: The delivery location this estimate is for (DeliverTo.label), e.g. 'Portland 97205'

quantity.desc: Shown when low (e.g. '9 left') or to the seller

maxPerOrder.desc: min(available, purchase limit); drives the quantity selector

price.desc: Price the customer pays now: the campaign price from promotions.priceOffers when a markdown or flash sale applies, else the offer price

regularPrice.desc: Offer price when a campaign price applies (shown separately when deal stock ends)

automaticDiscount.desc: Seller or platform discount the customer qualifies for without a code (from promotions)

total.desc: Item price + shipping − automatic discount, before tax. The comparable total.

ineligibleNote.desc: Shown under ineligible offers on the all-offers page

wasPriceRule.desc: From promotions, e.g. 'Was price is the seller's lowest price in the 30 days before Oct 6'

taxNote.desc: 'Totals include shipping; sales tax is added at checkout.'

selectedBy.desc: customer_choice keeps the seller the customer picked; never switched silently

featured.desc: Present when the customer chose a different offer, so both are visible

officialStore.desc: Present when the Official Store has an offer for this variant that can't be bought at this location while another seller's offer is selected (the 'Official Store out of stock, other sellers have it' state); null otherwise

state.desc: out_of_stock: no stock now; not_shippable: does not ship to the delivery location; unavailable: paused or not eligible

title.desc: e.g. 'Out of stock at the Official Store'

message.desc: e.g. 'Expected back around 2026-10-28 (estimate). Other sellers have it now.'

expectedRestockDate.desc: From inventory incoming stock; an estimate

price.desc: The Official Store's price for the variant

summary.desc: e.g. '$189.00 · In stock' or '2 offers from $184.00'

title.desc: e.g. 'Out of stock at the Official Store'

expectedRestockDate.desc: From inventory incoming stock; stated as an estimate

alternatives.desc: Other sellers' offers for the same variant

returnBaseline.desc: Category baseline the terms must meet

stockItemId.desc: The inventory stock item the offer sells from (for stock pages and bulk stock updates)

productReviewState.desc: From catalog; shown as a separate column

reviewNote.desc: Reviewer reason when changes were requested on the seller's own product

contentGaps.desc: Missing product content shown under the name (e.g. 'Missing images and identifiers'); empty when complete

fulfillmentNote.desc: For marketly_service offers: 'Fulfilled by Marketly: customers see Marketly's delivery terms. Your dispatch time and shipping profile are saved but apply only if you leave the service.'

endsAt.desc: Price reverts to the previous price at this time (e.g. end of an event)

marginBeforePct.desc: Official Store only, from inventory unit cost

expiresAt.desc: Preview must be applied before this; prices may have moved after

changePct.desc: Signed price change in percent when the row changes the price

largeChange.desc: Seller files: the row changes a published offer's price by more than largeSellerPriceChangePct, so apply needs confirmLargeChanges. Draft offers are exempt; always false on Official Store files (those go through price-change approval)

message.desc: What is wrong and how to fix it, e.g. 'Price $2.40 is below the $5.00 minimum for Cables and adapters. Did you mean $24.00?'

unitCost.desc: Weighted average buying cost from inventory

note.desc: e.g. 'Incoming 120 on PUR-2610-0042' or 'Product changes requested'

appealRoute.desc: Defaults to the seller appeal route from sellers

text.desc: Published wording, linked from the store and Seller rules

minOnTimeDispatchPct.desc: Seller on-time dispatch at or above this over the window

deliveryDayAdjustmentPct.desc: Added to the total, as % of item price, per business day slower than the fastest eligible offer

competingConditions.desc: Conditions that compete by default, e.g. ['new']; others compete only within their condition filter

tieBreakers.desc: Applied in order when adjusted totals are exactly equal: official_store (the Official Store's offer first), on_time_dispatch (better record first), earliest_publication. Offer id decides last. Version 2 (owner decision G17b): ['official_store', 'on_time_dispatch', 'earliest_publication']

adjustedTotal.desc: Total + delivery adjustment used for ranking

kind.desc: One change per line, checked in this order: removed, seller_restricted, availability, delivery, price, terms (terms only when the price did not change)

before.desc: Display text of the old value: price '$94.99', availability the quantity asked for ('3'), terms 'v2'; null for delivery, removed and seller_restricted. Read previous for the typed value.

after.desc: Display text of the new value: price '$99.99', availability the units that can be bought now ('1', '0'), delivery the location label that is not served, terms 'v3'; null for removed and seller_restricted. Read current for the typed value.

previous.desc: Typed old value, by kind: price → price (the line's price), availability → quantity (asked for), terms → termsVersion (the line's). Null for delivery, removed and seller_restricted

current.desc: Typed new value, by kind: price → price (now), availability → quantity (units that can be bought now, 0 when the offer is not active), delivery → postalCode (the location not served), terms → termsVersion (now). Null for removed and seller_restricted

alternatives.desc: Other offers for the same variant the customer may choose explicitly

sellerSku.desc: Seller's own code (Official Store: company SKU) at purchase, for packing slips, seller order search and exports

title.desc: Offer title at purchase (product title with variant label)

price.desc: Offer (regular) price at purchase. Campaign markdowns, flash prices, coupons and automatic discounts are not in it: the price the customer paid per unit comes from checkout (promotions evaluation) on the order item.

dispatch.desc: Effective dispatch terms at purchase (Offer.shipping.dispatch): Marketly's for marketly_service offers

fulfilledBy.desc: Offer.fulfilledBy at purchase; offers always sets it (optional only so snapshots built elsewhere, e.g. test fixtures, stay valid)

stateMachines.name: Offer status
stateMachines.notes: publish requires an approved, Active product (catalog.isPurchasable), an approved seller whose launch review has passed (before that, publish keeps the offer in draft with publish_on_approval and statusReason awaiting_launch_review; sellers.launch_review.decided with outcome passed publishes them), no restriction covering new listings, verified compare-at and return terms at or above the baseline. publish, resume and restoreEligibility land on out_of_stock straight away when inventory available = 0 (stockDepleted follows in the same transaction). restoreEligibility returns to the status held before (status_before_ineligible): a paused offer stays paused. makeIneligible is system-driven (seller restricted or suspended, product hidden or suspended) or a staff hold; it stops new sales of this offer only, never other sellers' offers. remove is staff (reason required) or the seller ending the offer (ended_by_seller). Removed offers stay readable for past orders, carts and audit. stockDepleted / stockRestored come from inventory.stock.changed.

stateMachines.name: Price change
stateMachines.notes: requestApproval when the change exceeds the caller's price-change limit from access (example: Official Store Manager ±30%); approve comes from access.approval.decided and goes to scheduled, which starts immediately when startsAt is past. revert runs at endsAt and restores revertTo. Seller price changes over the large-change threshold need confirmLargeChange, not an approval. A new change on an offer cancels its older scheduled change only if the caller says so; otherwise PRICE_CHANGE_PENDING.

stateMachines.name: Bulk update job
stateMachines.notes: Nothing changes until apply. Only rows marked ready are applied; error rows are skipped and listed in the correction report. Official Store rows above the price-change limit become pending_approval price changes.

The featured offer is marked; ineligible offers are listed with the reason. Postal code comes from the query, then the customer's default address, then the market default. Tabs: All, Active, Draft, Submitted, Changes requested, Rejected, Hidden or suspended; the heading reads '{all} offers across {productCount} products'. productDraft counts offers on unsubmitted product drafts; productPublication counts non-removed offers by the product's publication (active, hidden, suspended), matching the list's productPublication filter.

endpoints.summary: One own offer with product, stock, price history, status log and featured eligibility
Check an offer before saving: delivery a customer would see, price context, was-price check, return baseline
Create an offer on a catalog product (draft or published)
endpoints.desc: Creates the inventory stock item with the initial quantity. Used and refurbished need condition notes; anything missing from the product's included items must be listed. A draft on a product still in review can publish on approval. shippingProfileId must be one of the seller's own profiles (shipping.getProfileOwners; Official Store offers need an Official Store profile), otherwise SHIPPING_PROFILE_INVALID.

endpoints.summary: Edit offer terms or price
endpoints.desc: Customer-visible changes bump termsVersion so carts show the change before checkout. Price changes go into price history. A price change above largeSellerPriceChangePct needs confirmLargeChange: true in the same body, otherwise LARGE_PRICE_CHANGE_UNCONFIRMED and nothing is saved. shippingProfileId must be one of the seller's own profiles (shipping.getProfileOwners), otherwise SHIPPING_PROFILE_INVALID. Saving missingItems (changed or the same list, as a confirmation) clears missingItemsStale and publishes offers.offer.missing_items_reviewed.

endpoints.summary: Publish a draft offer

consumes.name: sellers.seller.restricted
consumes.does: Read affectedActivities and scope (categoryIds, conditions, offerIds, productIds; empty = whole account). sales: make the in-scope offers Ineligible (reason, affected activity and appeal route copied to statusReason; ineligible_source = restrictionId). new_listings / new_offers: refuse new in-scope offers and publishing drafts (SELLER_RESTRICTED). offer_reactivation: refuse resume and reactivation. Other sellers' offers are untouched (scenario 7).

consumes.name: sellers.restriction.updated
consumes.does: Re-apply the changed activities and scope: restore offers no longer covered, make newly covered offers Ineligible

consumes.name: sellers.restriction.lifted
consumes.does: restoreEligibility on offers whose ineligible_source is this restriction and that no remaining restriction covers

consumes.name: sellers.seller.suspended
consumes.does: Make all the seller's offers Ineligible (ineligible_source = suspensionId); new sales stop while open orders keep their snapshots

consumes.name: sellers.seller.reinstated
consumes.does: restoreEligibility on offers made ineligible by liftedRestrictionId or endedSuspensionId, except offers still covered by remainingRestrictionIds

consumes.name: sellers.launch_review.decided
consumes.does: outcome passed: publish the seller's drafts waiting with publish_on_approval (approved product, complete offer; out_of_stock when available = 0) and clear statusReason awaiting_launch_review. changes_needed: keep them in draft

consumes.name: sellers.seller.closed
consumes.does: Remove all the seller's offers (reason seller_closed)

consumes.name: catalog.brand.changed
consumes.does: A brand blocked, made official_only or authorized_list (or its authorized list changed): the offers on its products the brand no longer allows become Ineligible (brand_not_authorized, ineligible_source brand); offers it allows again come back unless another cause still stops them

consumes.name: catalog.product.publication_changed
consumes.does: Hidden or Suspended → offers Ineligible (product_hidden / product_suspended); Active → restoreEligibility

consumes.name: catalog.product.approved
consumes.does: Publish draft offers with publishOnApproval on that product; refresh content_gaps

consumes.name: catalog.product.merged
consumes.does: Move offers from the duplicate to the kept product, mapping variants by options; unmatched variants are paused and the seller told. Each moved offer's stock item follows it (inventory.updateStockItem with the kept productId / variantId) and its title is refreshed

consumes.name: catalog.product.updated
consumes.does: Set missing_items_stale on offers whose missingItems name items no longer in the product's box (or miss new box items) and publish offers.offer.missing_items_stale once per flag; seller asked to review; refresh title and content_gaps on the product's offers from catalog.getProductAdmin (missing images / identifiers)

consumes.name: inventory.stock.changed
consumes.does: available 0 → stockDepleted; available > 0 → stockRestored; mark featured decisions dirty

consumes.name: access.approval.decided
consumes.does: Approve or reject pending price changes (and pending bulk rows)

consumes.name: trust.enforcement.recorded
consumes.does: Remove or hold offers named in an enforcement (counterfeit, abuse); status_reason keeps the enforcementId so a reversal can find them

consumes.name: trust.enforcement.reversed
consumes.does: Undo what trust.enforcement.recorded did for that enforcementId (inbox-claimed per event): offers it removed go back to Paused (same path as reinstateOffer, stock item unarchived by inventory, seller told and asked to resume); offers it held are released to their previous status; offers since changed by someone else (seller ended, staff removed for another reason) are left alone (noted in offer_status_log; trust's owner work item covers the rest). Publishes offers.offer.status_changed with trustEnforcementId

consumes.name: promotions.campaign.started
consumes.does: Mark featured decisions dirty for offers whose automatic discount changes the comparable total

consumes.name: fulfillment-service.offer.service_changed
consumes.does: Inbox-claimed per event: set fulfilled_by (marketly_service or seller), bump terms_version and mark featured decisions dirty. With sellable false make the offer Ineligible (statusReason fulfillment_service_suspended, ineligible_source { kind: fulfillment_service, id: skuEnrollmentId }); with sellable true (or fulfilledBy seller) restoreEligibility on offers whose ineligible_source is fulfillment_service

notes: Product vs offer (plan ch. 5, 8): offers never edit shared content; corrections go through catalog suggestCorrection from the offer form.

Featured-offer rule (published, versioned, default v1): (1) Eligible: offer Active, seller in good standing with no open restriction, on-time dispatch ≥ minOnTimeDispatchPct over performanceWindowDays, not under delivery review, product purchasable. (2) Available: available > 0 and ships to the delivery location. (3) Delivery: each business day slower than the fastest eligible offer adds deliveryDayAdjustmentPct of the item price to the ranking total. (4) Total price: item + shipping − automatic discounts. Lowest adjusted total wins; exact ties go through the version's tieBreakers in order (official_store, on_time_dispatch, earliest_publication; a version listing none uses on-time dispatch, then earlier publication). Owner decision G17b (2026-10-16): the lowest delivered total wins and the Official Store wins an exact tie: new installs start with that rule (deliveryDayAdjustmentPct 0, tieBreakers official_store first); installs that had rule versions get it as a new version from the 2026-10-16 data migration, and decisions made earlier keep their version. Only competingConditions (New) compete by default; used/refurbished compete within their condition filter. Advertising never affects it.
A customer's explicit offer choice is passed as offerId; the purchase box and cart keep that seller. revalidate reports changes but never substitutes another seller (scenario 2).

Comparable totals need a delivery location: postalCode query → customer default address → market default (settings). Shipping estimates come from shipping.quote(profileId, postalCode, variant dimensions); when shipping is off, delivery shows the dispatch label only.
Was-price authenticity: compareAt is shown only when verified (price history or list price on file) and carries its explanation; the nightly job drops stale ones.

Prices and promotions: offers owns the offer (regular) price, its history and direct price changes (seller edits, Official Store price changes with start/end and approval). Campaign markdowns, flash prices and coupons are promotions; store views call promotions.priceOffers and show the campaign price with regularPrice beside it. promotions.referencePrice reads offers.lowestPrice, so there is one price history.

Return terms: the effective terms come from returns.resolveTerms(sellerId, categoryId, condition); an offer may only choose terms at least as generous (kind = extended), never less (RETURN_TERMS_BELOW_BASELINE).

Seller stock lives in inventory with one stock item per seller offer; Official Store offers link to company stock items (one per company SKU, e.g. HAL-AUR-BLK-LN for a used-like-new unit created from a return outcome). Seller stock is never mixed with company stock.

The seller bulk file covers price and quantity together because both are keyed by seller SKU, which offers owns; offers validates every row and applies quantities through inventory.applyBulkQuantities (recorded as 'Bulk update' adjustments). Bulk file tools are plan phase 2; selected-row price changes are phase 1.
Official Store price-change limits are approval limits in access (a role limit, not a setting here). Granting someone offers.official.price does not raise their limit.
Company trading figures on admin/official (sales, margin, discounts, returns) come from finance/reports; offers supplies per-offer margin using inventory unit cost.

Dependencies differ from the architecture table only by optional ones: shipping (delivery quotes), returns (baseline validation), promotions (automatic discounts in comparable totals), access (approval requests), audit.

Seller list support: content_gaps is a copy of the product's missing images / identifiers (catalog ProductAdmin.missing), kept on each offer row so GET /offers can filter by missingContent without a cross-module join. Tab counts combine offer status with the product review state copied from catalog.

Exports: seller offer exports run through reports (registerDataset / requestExport) like every other module's exports. Offers registers dataset offers.seller.offers (seller audience; columns: product, variant, seller SKU, condition, price, compare-at, available, review state, publication, status, updated at) and serves it from POST /api/seller/offers/offers/exports. Bulk hide of selected rows (POST /offers/bulk-pause) is phase 1 like selected-row price changes.

Uniqueness is enforced by the database for the Official Store too (seller_id null): unique nulls not distinct on (owner_type, seller_id, seller_sku) and on (owner_type, seller_id, variant_id) for live New offers, and one live offer per stock item (unique stock_item_id where status <> 'removed'). The service checks stay for friendly DUPLICATE_OFFER details; a 23505 from these indexes maps to DUPLICATE_OFFER too.

Stock item follows the offer: a draft's variant change and a catalog merge move the stock item with inventory.updateStockItem(stockItemId, { productId, variantId }); removal archives and reinstatement unarchives it (inventory on offers.offer.status_changed). No stale stock item is left on the old variant.

Official Store ships-from (decision O3): DispatchTerms.shipsFrom of Official Store offers is the inventory default location (inventory.getDefaultLocation(): 'City, Region', else its name), not a constant. It is set when the offer is saved and refreshed on every Official Store offer by the hourly offers.reevaluate-eligibility job; inventory publishes no event when the default location changes, so a change shows within the hour.
Offer title (decision O4): the title column of the offers table is denormalised from catalog so admin q search and shipping's profile usage lists need no catalog join.

Trust enforcements on offers (decision D8): suspend_offer / remove_offer recommendations are owned by the Catalog Manager, who holds offers.offers.remove. Reversals arrive as trust.enforcement.reversed and are undone here (see consumes).

Shipping profile ownership: create, update and bulk rows that set shippingProfileId check the owner with shipping.getProfileOwners([profileId]) (seller id, or official); a profile of another seller is SHIPPING_PROFILE_INVALID.

Fulfilled by Marketly (fulfillment-service, phase 4): offers.fulfilled_by is official_warehouse for Official Store offers and seller for seller offers (backfilled), and follows fulfillment-service.offer.service_changed. Read paths (getOffer, getOffers, quoteOffer, getOfferView, compareOffers, storefront views, revalidate, snapshotForOrder) resolve Offer.shipping for marketly_service rows with one batched fulfillment-service.getServiceTerms call. If the fulfillment service is off or returns null for such a row, the offer is treated as not sellable (Ineligible view), never as seller-shipped (decision D5). The delivery estimate and the featured rule use the effective profile and dispatch; SellerCue keeps the seller name while DeliveryEstimate.shipsFrom and fulfilledByLabel say Marketly. Seller edits of dispatch or shipping profile on a service offer are saved but have no customer effect while it is a service offer (SellerOfferDetail.fulfillmentNote).
